title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Provenance
description: Component schema (not a top-level module document kind). Shape only — the ordering invariants (`published_at <= modified_at <= retrieved_at`), the precedence rule for "the date of the evidence", and the `retrieved_at <= entity.updated_at` relationship with the core envelope are pure/entity-context semantic rules, not expressible here (specification.md §8). `retrieved_at` records when the producer fetched the source and MUST NOT be presented as the date of the content.
